name: web-retro-snowboard-brand-site-black-yellow-and-pastel-tiles
title: Retro snowboarding site: yellow and black sections, coloured icon tiles and tilted athlete cards
whatItIs: A tall page with a yellow hero where a skier photo sits inside a wavy blob shape above 'Shred the Limits, Embrace the Cold', a black section with a yellow button and five coloured icon tiles, tilted athlete cards in orange, green and purple, a huge cropped 'Hard Live' title with photos, a yellow rules grid and a giant closing wordmark.
whatItMeans: Loud, retro and irreverent; saturated colour blocks give a 90s board-sport feel.
techniques: Crop hero photos in wavy blob masks.
Alternate yellow and black full-width sections.
Tilt athlete cards on bright fills.
Use tall condensed type for headlines and a giant cropped closing word.

vocabulary.definition: An organic wavy shape used to crop an image.
A coloured card presenting one person.
A rounded coloured square with a pictogram.
A giant word cut at the bottom edge.
